scheme_name: Haryana Gaurav Samman Scheme for Padma Awardees
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a resident of Haryana
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) number issued by the Citizen Resource Information Department (CRID)
Applicant must be a recipient of a Padma Award (Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan or Padma Shri)
Honorarium stops upon the death of the awardee (payable for the month of death to a nominee)
Honorarium stops if the Padma award is revoked or returned
Violation of scheme conditions makes the applicant ineligible
benefits_summary: Monthly honorarium of ₹10,000 plus free travel on all Haryana Roadways buses.
